title: Figure 3: Illustration of quantum optical homodyne tomography (Wigner function)
description: 3D wireframe plot of a Wigner function shown as a hill on a gridded phase-space plane with axes q and p, with a vertical 2D plane showing a projected curve. Caption reads "Figure 3. Illustration of Quantum Optical Homodyne Tomography (courtesy of Ulf Leonhardt)." The caption explains the vertical plane represents measured projections and the vertical axis is the Wigner quasiprobability magnitude.
